edges: Mirabell and Fainall have just finished playing cards.
Mirabell is informed by a footman that Waitwell and Foible were married that morning.
Mirabell tells Fainall about his love for Millamant.
Mirabell will lose £6000 of Millamant's inheritance if Lady Wishfort marries.
Mrs. Fainall tells Mirabell that she hates her husband.
Millamant expresses her displeasure in Mirabell's plan.
Mirabell offers to help Lady Wishfort out of an embarrassing situation if she consents to his marriage.
Lady Wishfort offers Mirabell her consent to the marriage if he can save her fortune and honour.
Mrs. Fainall gives all her property to Mirabell.
Mirabell and Millamant discuss the conditions under which they would accept each other in marriage.
Mirabell restores Mrs. Fainall's property to her possession.
Mirabell is free to marry Millamant with the full £6000 inheritance.
